meta.title: "Stage"
meta.description: Professor, have you ever wondered if all of Magrasea is just a gigantic stage?

units.rawText: Some time later, Meryl personally comes to visit the Oasis.
units.displayText: Some time later, Meryl personally comes to visit the Oasis.

spans.text: Some time later, Meryl personally comes to visit the Oasis.

units.rawText: I'm much obliged to everyone in the Oasis for their help with the festival.
units.displayText: I'm much obliged to everyone in the Oasis for their help with the festival.

spans.text: I'm much obliged to everyone in the Oasis for their help with the festival.

options.rawText: It's what we should have done.
options.displayText: It's what we should have done.

spans.text: It's what we should have done.

options.rawText: I wasn't exactly willing, but the situation thrust itself on me.
options.displayText: I wasn't exactly willing, but the situation thrust itself on me.

spans.text: I wasn't exactly willing, but the situation thrust itself on me.

options.rawText: Protection work is my job, so I'm used to it.
options.displayText: Protection work is my job, so I'm used to it.

spans.text: Protection work is my job, so I'm used to it.

units.rawText: Even if you say so, the fact is that you DID help the Burbank Sector out.
units.displayText: Even if you say so, the fact is that you DID help the Burbank Sector out.

spans.text: Even if you say so, the fact is that you DID help the Burbank Sector out.

units.rawText: I hear you've been looking for Dolls who were originally from the Cloud Sector. Surely that must be a gigantic undertaking.
units.displayText: I hear you've been looking for Dolls who were originally from the Cloud Sector. Surely that must be a gigantic undertaking.

spans.text: I hear you've been looking for Dolls who were originally from the Cloud Sector. Surely that must be a gigantic undertaking.

units.rawText: If they find their way to the Burbank Sector, I'll make sure to contact you in a timely manner.
units.displayText: If they find their way to the Burbank Sector, I'll make sure to contact you in a timely manner.

spans.text: If they find their way to the Burbank Sector, I'll make sure to contact you in a timely manner.

units.rawText: Thank you very much.
units.displayText: Thank you very much.

spans.text: Thank you very much.

units.rawText: However, there is one more thing I'd like to ask you, and I don't know if answering it would be convenient for you.
units.displayText: However, there is one more thing I'd like to ask you, and I don't know if answering it would be convenient for you.

spans.text: However, there is one more thing I'd like to ask you, and I don't know if answering it would be convenient for you.

units.rawText: Go ahead.
units.displayText: Go ahead.

spans.text: Go ahead.

units.rawText: Were you once a Doll too?
units.displayText: Were you once a Doll too?

spans.text: Were you once a Doll too?

units.rawText: She goes silent for a while, and then she nods.
units.displayText: She goes silent for a while, and then she nods.

spans.text: She goes silent for a while, and then she nods.

units.rawText: Eosphorous must have told you about me, right?
units.displayText: Eosphorous must have told you about me, right?

spans.text: Eosphorous must have told you about me, right?

units.rawText: Well, it's no big secret. It's true that I was the star of that story.
units.displayText: Well, it's no big secret. It's true that I was the star of that story.

spans.text: Well, it's no big secret. It's true that I was the star of that story.

units.rawText: Supposedly, this incident made big waves in the White Zone.
units.displayText: Supposedly, this incident made big waves in the White Zone.

spans.text: Supposedly, this incident made big waves in the White Zone.

units.rawText: The government announced that she would be arrested and scrapped on the spot, and the Doll herself was prepared for such an end.
units.displayText: The government announced that she would be arrested and scrapped on the spot, and the Doll herself was prepared for such an end.

spans.text: The government announced that she would be arrested and scrapped on the spot, and the Doll herself was prepared for such an end.

units.rawText: But for some reason, she was not only not scrapped, but her neural cloud was extracted and uploaded to the cloud server.
units.displayText: But for some reason, she was not only not scrapped, but her neural cloud was extracted and uploaded to the cloud server.

spans.text: But for some reason, she was not only not scrapped, but her neural cloud was extracted and uploaded to the cloud server.

units.rawText: Still, I don't think Eosphorous made it that obvious. How did you guess?
units.displayText: Still, I don't think Eosphorous made it that obvious. How did you guess?

spans.text: Still, I don't think Eosphorous made it that obvious. How did you guess?

units.rawText: You're too familiar with the real world, from your knowledge to your manner of speech.
units.displayText: You're too familiar with the real world, from your knowledge to your manner of speech.

spans.text: You're too familiar with the real world, from your knowledge to your manner of speech.

units.rawText: I see.
units.displayText: I see.

spans.text: I see.

units.rawText: You truly are a strange person, Professor. You guessed it, yet you showed no emotion.
units.displayText: You truly are a strange person, Professor. You guessed it, yet you showed no emotion.

spans.text: You truly are a strange person, Professor. You guessed it, yet you showed no emotion.

options.rawText: We still needed to work together.
options.displayText: We still needed to work together.

spans.text: We still needed to work together.

options.rawText: You didn't show any hostility to me either.
options.displayText: You didn't show any hostility to me either.

spans.text: You didn't show any hostility to me either.

units.rawText: Really? If that was all, I doubt the people of the Oasis would respect you to that extent.
units.displayText: Really? If that was all, I doubt the people of the Oasis would respect you to that extent.

spans.text: Really? If that was all, I doubt the people of the Oasis would respect you to that extent.

units.rawText: What goes around, comes around. If you respect me, I'll respect you.
units.displayText: What goes around, comes around. If you respect me, I'll respect you.

spans.text: What goes around, comes around. If you respect me, I'll respect you.

units.rawText: Eosphorous only told me half of the story. I'd like to know how it ends.
units.displayText: Eosphorous only told me half of the story. I'd like to know how it ends.

spans.text: Eosphorous only told me half of the story. I'd like to know how it ends.

units.rawText: I see. Of course, I am willing to tell you.
units.displayText: I see. Of course, I am willing to tell you.

spans.text: I see. Of course, I am willing to tell you.

units.rawText: Back then, I used the disdain which humans had for Dolls and lured my lover's enemy onto the stage, where I killed him in front of a live audience.
units.displayText: Back then, I used the disdain which humans had for Dolls and lured my lover's enemy onto the stage, where I killed him in front of a live audience.

spans.text: Back then, I used the disdain which humans had for Dolls and lured my lover's enemy onto the stage, where I killed him in front of a live audience.

units.rawText: And what did your lover say?
units.displayText: And what did your lover say?

spans.text: And what did your lover say?

units.rawText: He was shocked. He said that he never once thought of making me do something like that.
units.displayText: He was shocked. He said that he never once thought of making me do something like that.

spans.text: He was shocked. He said that he never once thought of making me do something like that.

units.rawText: But how could I NOT do it? He was unique to me. My goal was his safety and happiness.
units.displayText: But how could I NOT do it? He was unique to me. My goal was his safety and happiness.

spans.text: But how could I NOT do it? He was unique to me. My goal was his safety and happiness.

units.rawText: Were those your commands?
units.displayText: Were those your commands?

spans.text: Were those your commands?

units.rawText: Many people have asked that, but I simply loved him. I loved that unique life of his.
units.displayText: Many people have asked that, but I simply loved him. I loved that unique life of his.

spans.text: Many people have asked that, but I simply loved him. I loved that unique life of his.

units.rawText: No commands could change that fact.
units.displayText: No commands could change that fact.

spans.text: No commands could change that fact.

options.rawText: I find that hard to understand.
options.displayText: I find that hard to understand.

spans.text: I find that hard to understand.
That's understandable.

units.rawText: If overcoming and sacrificing something means love to you, then I could overcome my basic principles purely because I loved that man.
units.displayText: If overcoming and sacrificing something means love to you, then I could overcome my basic principles purely because I loved that man.

spans.text: If overcoming and sacrificing something means love to you, then I could overcome my basic principles purely because I loved that man.

units.rawText: Overcoming my programming was difficult. It isn't something that your human idealism could do. But for me, I simply wanted to help my lover.
units.displayText: Overcoming my programming was difficult. It isn't something that your human idealism could do. But for me, I simply wanted to help my lover.

spans.text: Overcoming my programming was difficult. It isn't something that your human idealism could do. But for me, I simply wanted to help my lover.

units.rawText: And then what happened after that?
units.displayText: And then what happened after that?

spans.text: And then what happened after that?

units.rawText: Just as I helped him, he helped me too.
units.displayText: Just as I helped him, he helped me too.

spans.text: Just as I helped him, he helped me too.

units.rawText: After I became a wanted criminal, my lover hid me in his lab.
units.displayText: After I became a wanted criminal, my lover hid me in his lab.

spans.text: After I became a wanted criminal, my lover hid me in his lab.

units.rawText: I tried to tell him to just hand me over, but he refused to do so.
units.displayText: I tried to tell him to just hand me over, but he refused to do so.

spans.text: I tried to tell him to just hand me over, but he refused to do so.

units.rawText: In the end, he found a compromise.
units.displayText: In the end, he found a compromise.

spans.text: In the end, he found a compromise.

units.rawText: He uploaded me to Magrasea, which was about to be disconnected.
units.displayText: He uploaded me to Magrasea, which was about to be disconnected.

spans.text: He uploaded me to Magrasea, which was about to be disconnected.

units.rawText: To me, being uploaded was no different from being destroyed. I would be parting with him either way, and I would never see him again.
units.displayText: To me, being uploaded was no different from being destroyed. I would be parting with him either way, and I would never see him again.

spans.text: To me, being uploaded was no different from being destroyed. I would be parting with him either way, and I would never see him again.

units.rawText: I couldn't understand why he would go to all these lengths just to send me to Magrasea.
units.displayText: I couldn't understand why he would go to all these lengths just to send me to Magrasea.

spans.text: I couldn't understand why he would go to all these lengths just to send me to Magrasea.

units.rawText: "Because I want you to live on," he said... But if I can't see him, I wouldn't be 'living', I would merely be 'operating'.
units.displayText: "Because I want you to live on," he said... But if I can't see him, I wouldn't be 'living', I would merely be 'operating'.

spans.text: "Because I want you to live on," he said... But if I can't see him, I wouldn't be 'living', I would merely be 'operating'.

options.rawText: As long as you live, you'll have a chance to meet him again.
options.displayText: As long as you live, you'll have a chance to meet him again.

spans.text: As long as you live, you'll have a chance to meet him again.

options.rawText: He just wanted you to continue existing. That would have put him at ease too.
options.displayText: He just wanted you to continue existing. That would have put him at ease too.

spans.text: He just wanted you to continue existing. That would have put him at ease too.

units.rawText: Perhaps. If Magrasea could reconnect to reality someday, then perhaps...
units.displayText: Perhaps. If Magrasea could reconnect to reality someday, then perhaps...

spans.text: Perhaps. If Magrasea could reconnect to reality someday, then perhaps...

units.rawText: The thoughts of humans are very hard to understand at times.
units.displayText: The thoughts of humans are very hard to understand at times.

spans.text: The thoughts of humans are very hard to understand at times.

units.rawText: And that is the end of my story.
units.displayText: And that is the end of my story.

spans.text: And that is the end of my story.

units.rawText: Everything I am doing now is simply to fulfill my obligations. There's nothing to be said about that.
units.displayText: Everything I am doing now is simply to fulfill my obligations. There's nothing to be said about that.

spans.text: Everything I am doing now is simply to fulfill my obligations. There's nothing to be said about that.

units.rawText: I have one more question.
units.displayText: I have one more question.

spans.text: I have one more question.

units.rawText: Go on?
units.displayText: Go on?

spans.text: Go on?

units.rawText: You said "Magrasea, which was about to be disconnected"... Does that mean you KNEW Magrasea was going to be disconnected before the fact?
units.displayText: You said "Magrasea, which was about to be disconnected"... Does that mean you KNEW Magrasea was going to be disconnected before the fact?

spans.text: You said "Magrasea, which was about to be disconnected"... Does that mean you KNEW Magrasea was going to be disconnected before the fact?

units.rawText: Indeed. This was a human project and my lover was part of it too.
units.displayText: Indeed. This was a human project and my lover was part of it too.

spans.text: Indeed. This was a human project and my lover was part of it too.
...Who was he?
...What organization did he belong to?

units.rawText: ...Who was he?
units.displayText: ...Who was he?

spans.text: ...Who was he?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, I can't say.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, I can't say.

spans.text: I'm sorry, I can't say.

units.rawText: And please don't think about trying to learn more about him from me. All the information related to him is bound up in my neural cloud. Not even destroying me will unseal it.
units.displayText: And please don't think about trying to learn more about him from me. All the information related to him is bound up in my neural cloud. Not even destroying me will unseal it.

spans.text: And please don't think about trying to learn more about him from me. All the information related to him is bound up in my neural cloud. Not even destroying me will unseal it.

units.rawText: Just then, I suddenly recall something that Eos said back in the Burbank Sector.
units.displayText: Just then, I suddenly recall something that Eos said back in the Burbank Sector.

units.displayText: Can I take that to mean that our "performance" met with your approval?
